No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Support Our New Flour Brand, BUA Foods Urges Distributors by Longtong Yakubu 7 seconds ago in Business Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram BUA Foods Plc has urged distributors, wholesalers and retailers to support the nationwide distribution of its newly launched Bakers Pride Flour, saying consistent availability would be central to the product’s success.
The charge was given over the weekend at the trade launch of the flour brand in Kano, which brought together bakers, bakery owners, distributors, and other industry stakeholders.
General Manager, Sales, Alim Liman, said the success of Bakers Pride Flour would depend largely on effective distribution, market availability and collaboration with trade partners.
He urged distributors, wholesalers and retailers to support the movement of the product across the country, stressing that consistent availability would build customer confidence and encourage repeat purchases.
“Bakers Pride Flour was designed based on an understanding of the realities of Nigerian bakers and carries a simple promise in every bag: reliable performance, consistent quality, and confidence in every bake,” the Managing Director of BUA Foods, Ayodele Abioye, said at the event.
Abioye said the company developed the product to support bakers and strengthen businesses across the food value chain, adding that improved productivity and better value for bakers would have positive effects on distributors, retailers, employees and communities.
Also speaking, the General Manager, Brand and Corporate Communications, Adewunmi Desalu, said Bakers Pride Flour was developed with the everyday needs of bakers in mind.
She said baking required a balance between the quality of finished products and the commercial realities of running a bakery, noting that BUA Foods aimed to establish the brand as a dependable option for bread-making and other baking applications.
Liman said BUA Foods would support bakers through product demonstrations, baking trials, technical assistance and product education.
The company said Bakers Pride Flour was built around three pillars: Smart Choice, Dependable Baking and More Possibilities.
It said the flour was suitable for various baking applications, including bread loaves, gurasa and other baked products.
The launch comes as bakers contend with rising production costs and increasing competition in Nigeria’s baking industry.
